classification: Original custom additive maintenance support primitive; no existing native functionality extracted

upstream_provenance.note: Later upstream and custom revisions below identify historical review data only, not this primitive or an accepted updated harness.

source_identity.scope_limits: Recorded scope covers codex-rs/component-sdk/MODULE.bazel/MODULE.bazel.lock, not every root document or untracked recovery file.

symbols.role: Bounded canonical JSON and deterministic content identity; not authenticity
Retain legacy impact blockers and incomplete path coverage
Frozen canonical plan bytes with content-derived identity
Explicit membership selection, dependency/coherent-group/component constraints and per-owner rule bindings
Recompute exact canonical result and verify expected plan ID

contracts.wire_exposure: None in this slice; pure Python API and supplied contract-version-1 documents
contracts.outputs: Frozen canonical SelectionPlan.payload, plan_id and reconstructed document; result status blocked or scoped_plan; no authority granted
contracts.state_owner: Caller owns persistence/profile history; this module has no filesystem or process state
contracts.lifecycle: Synchronous pure call; malformed/unsupported inputs raise PolicyError, findings return blocked; no process start/stop or storage transaction

historical_fixture_lineage.scope: Retained historical actual-review projection; fixture-only supplied-evidence refusal, not a fresh Git invocation or semantic ownership audit
historical_fixture_lineage.verification_method: Read/decode retained capsule manifest; independently reconstruct required schema/status/unresolved/summary/path-findings projection; compare canonical SHA and exact projection objects; no product code import or execution.

scope.split: Immutable selection/permission plan first; full final inventory diff audit preserved separately.
scope.complex_guidance: Further splitting graph closure, per-owner permission binding and immutable evidence identity would expose a partially checked plan; the coherent first boundary retains all fail-closed validation. Tests cover actual holes found by static review; fixture data is mechanical exact projection.

intentional_custom_changes: Immutable explicit selection/permission plan identity separate from installed plugin IDs and Cxx inventory IDs
Membership expansion does not silently add dependencies; containing component and atomic-group constraints cannot be bypassed by selecting features/members
Exact owner/path/category/before/origin bindings with unsupported fragment scopes rejected
Historical actual impact gaps remain blocked; supplied graph and inventory digests are not promoted to source/semantic attestation
scope_limits: Pure supplied-evidence policy fixtures only; no installed planning capability, package build/install/invocation, real host or GUI acceptance in this slice.
Graph ownership, mapping and dependency declarations are supplied assertions; this module does not discover or attest their current semantic truth.
Whole-file scope bindings are checked; actual final diffs/operations/content and filesystem completeness are not collected or audited.
Allowed operations are validated and retained, not checked against actual before/after changes. Symbol literals are identity bindings, not semantic scope enforcement.
Baseline inventory SHA is bound but baseline inventory bytes are not provided or verified by this primitive.
Frozen canonical bytes and restore/revalidation detect altered results or stale expected IDs; they do not authenticate publishers or persist profiles/receipts.
4MiB canonical JSON and structural row limits do not establish a measured CPU/deadline/cancellation budget; installed exposure requires separate work admission and cancellation.
No sandbox, state migration, candidate build/activation, A/B routing, snapshot/catch-up, external recovery or rollback behavior is implemented or accepted.
Prior installed 0.3 and 0.2 GUI/storage results retain their original source identities and are not retested or relabeled here.
No new native extracted subsystem; current native build capacity gate remains closed.
